LanguageData.CC_SetTip_SpeechShows: Everything Rimfolk's colonists say shows one way: a wish, a word about the weather, how they really are, a meeting's back and forth, a moment between two of them. With Interaction Bubbles it can all be speech bubbles, like the game's own chats; without it, short lines of floating text over the speaker. A line one person says never goes into the Log tab; moments between two people are kept there either way.
LanguageData.CC_SpeechShows_Bubbles_Tip: Speech bubbles when Interaction Bubbles is loaded, floating text when it isn't. Its own toggle among the play settings hides them all.
LanguageData.CC_SpeechShows_Floating_Tip: Short lines of floating text over the speaker, even with Interaction Bubbles loaded (its bubbles keep showing the game's own chats).
LanguageData.CC_SpeechShows_Off_Tip: Nothing over anyone's head from Rimfolk. Moments between two people are still kept in the social log.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_SpeechShows_Bubbles: Everything colonists say shows as speech bubbles with Interaction Bubbles, else as floating text.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_SpeechShows_Floating: Everything colonists say floats over their heads as short lines of text.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_SpeechShows_Off: Colonists say nothing over their heads; the social log still keeps their moments.
